name: Hopper X-Treme
summary: Adds upgraded hoppers in several speed tiers, multi-hoppers that output to several sides, huppers that push items upward, glazed variants that eject items like droppers, and built-in item filtering with include/exclude filter items. Includes an in-game guide book.

new_content.name: Copper Hopper
new_content.notes: 8 ticks (vanilla speed) but ignores redstone locking.

new_content.name: Netherite Hopper
new_content.how_to_obtain: Smithing: netherite upgrade template + Diamond Hopper + netherite ingot

new_content.name: Nether Star Hopper
new_content.notes: 1 tick, moves up to 16 items per transfer; fastest tier.

new_content.name: Multi-Hoppers (plain, golden, diamond, netherite, nether star)
new_content.how_to_obtain: 4 hoppers of the tier (shapeless); plain multi-hopper from 4 vanilla hoppers. Golden/diamond also from the previous multi-hopper + 4 gold ingots/diamonds. A multi-hopper can be crafted back into 4 hoppers.
new_content.notes: Output to more than one side.

new_content.name: Huppers and Multi-Huppers (all tiers incl. honeyed, copper)
new_content.how_to_obtain: Craft the matching hopper alone (shapeless) to get the hupper; reversible the same way
new_content.notes: Push items upward for vertical item elevators.

new_content.name: Glazed variants (Glazed, Honey Glazed, Glazed Golden/Diamond/Netherite/Nether Star, plus glazed multi-hoppers)
new_content.how_to_obtain: Hopper + gray glazed terracotta (shapeless), or upgrade a glazed hopper with the tier material; shaped: iron ingots, chest, gray glazed terracotta (IGI/ICI/ I )
new_content.notes: Do not hold items; eject them in the facing direction like a dropper.

new_content.name: Hopper Item Filter
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shaped: #W#/#C#/### with sticks, cobweb (W), iron chain (C)
new_content.notes: Include or Exclude mode, up to 5 entries.

new_content.name: Wrench
new_content.how_to_obtain: Shaped: 4 iron ingots in a diagonal wrench shape

new_content.name: Filtered hoppers (deprecated)
new_content.notes: Auto-convert to filter-capable equivalents when placed.

mechanics.title: Filtering
mechanics.description: Upgraded hoppers accept a filter item; include mode passes only listed items, exclude mode blocks listed items.

vanilla_changes.change: Vanilla hopper unchanged; used as base for upgrades. Shapeless: 4 hoppers -> Multi-Hopper; Multi-Hopper -> 4 hoppers.

editor_notes: Author's own mod. Creative tabs: Hoppers, Multi-Hoppers, Huppers, Multi-Huppers. Netherite multi-hopper etc. follow the same 4-hoppers rule. Wrench is 4 iron ingots in pattern ' # ',' ##','#  ' (count per the pattern). Verify how filters are inserted into hoppers.
